description: This file appears to be a C header file defining an API for managing a set of object IDs (oids) using a hash table. It includes data structures, initialization, insertion, removal, containment checks, and iteration functions for oid sets, with functions to parse oids from a file. The focus is on memory-efficient storage and duplicate removal.

classes.name: struct oidset
classes.description: A structure representing a set of object IDs using a hash table, should be zero-initialized or initialized with oidset_init.

classes.name: struct oidset_iter
classes.description: Iterator structure for traversing the oidset hash table.

methods.name: oidset_init
methods.description: Initializes an oidset structure, optionally preallocating space.

methods.name: oidset_contains
methods.description: Checks if the set contains a given oid.

methods.name: oidset_equal
methods.description: Checks if two oidsets contain the same oids.

methods.name: oidset_insert
methods.description: Inserts an oid into the set; returns 1 if oid was already present, 0 otherwise.

methods.name: oidset_insert_from_set
methods.description: Inserts all oids from one set into another.

methods.name: oidset_remove
methods.description: Removes an oid from the set.

methods.name: int oidset_size(const struct oidset * set)
methods.description: Returns the number of oids in the set.

methods.name: oidset_clear
methods.description: Removes all entries from the oidset, freeing resources.

methods.name: oidset_parse_file
methods.description: Populates an oidset from a file containing object ids.

methods.name: oidset_parse_file_carefully
methods.description: Same as above, but with a callback to tweak parsed oids.

methods.name: void oidset_iter_init(const struct oidset * set,struct oidset_iter * iter)
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for traversing the oidset.

methods.name: struct:object_id * oidset_iter_next(struct oidset_iter * iter)
methods.description: Returns the next object_id in iteration, or NULL if end reached.

methods.name: struct:object_id * oidset_iter_first(struct oidset * set,struct oidset_iter * iter)
methods.description: Resets iteration and returns the first object_id.
